name: Moxy Solo
short_description: Playful, design-led Moxy select-service hotel on Solo's central Slamet Riyadi Street, with a rooftop pool, Sky Bar and games-filled lobby steps from Pura Mangkunegaran palace.
ai_summary: Moxy Solo is Marriott's playful, select-service lifestyle hotel and the first Marriott International property in Solo (Surakarta), Central Java, opened in July 2024. Set on the vibrant central artery of Slamet Riyadi Street, its 108 compact, design-led rooms use modular furniture and signature peg walls, paired with 55-inch TVs and walk-in showers. Independent reviewers and a strong TripAdvisor base (4.8/5, ranked #1 of 57 B&Bs/inns in Solo) consistently praise the unbeatable location, walkable to Pura Mangkunegaran palace, the Ngarsopura night market and the Sunday Car Free Day, alongside an energetic, genuinely helpful young crew and fun social spaces including a games-filled lobby, a Library and Plug-In work area, a rooftop pool and the Sky Bar. Bonvoy elite guests report generous daily food credits and willing upgrades. The honest watch-outs are typical of both the Moxy brand and a new hotel: rooms are small and minimalist with no in-room fridge, limited wardrobe and bathroom shelf space, and soundproofing is weak, so street and night-market noise can carry. Breakfast at the Moxy Bar and Restaurant draws mixed notes, with the kitchen occasionally struggling at peak hours. Overall it reads as a stylish, well-located and well-priced base for exploring Solo, best suited to couples, solo travellers and younger guests over families.

faqs.question: Is Moxy Solo a good base for sightseeing in Solo?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moxy Solo sits on central Slamet Riyadi Street, within a short walk of Pura Mangkunegaran palace, the Ngarsopura night market and the Sunday Car Free Day. Keraton Surakarta, Solo Paragon mall and plenty of local eateries are a few minutes away, making it an excellent base for exploring the city on foot.

faqs.question: Does Moxy Solo include breakfast, and what is dining like?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is served at the Moxy Bar and Restaurant but is not automatically included in every rate, so check your booking. Bonvoy elite members typically receive a daily food credit. Reviewers praise the variety yet note the kitchen can struggle at peak hours, with limited hot food and weak coffee.

faqs.question: How far is Moxy Solo from the airport?
faqs.answer: Adisumarmo International Airport (SOC), Solo's main airport, is roughly 14 kilometres north of the hotel, about a 20-minute drive depending on traffic. No complimentary shuttle is advertised, but taxis and ride-hailing apps such as Grab and Gojek are readily available and inexpensive for the short transfer into the city centre.
